subjects.description: The black sports car of the request: a low, wide two-door performance car with a smooth closed body, dark glass, and a long bonnet, treated as a new object in the target scene rather than a copy of the reference frame.

references.description: Visual style reference supplying the live-action, cinematic rendering, contrast range and palette of the finished footage; it does not supply the car's pose, framing or lighting.
references.retention_details: Only the live-action cinematic look, its contrast and its palette transfer. The reference's showroom lighting, its static pose and its composition are not carried over.

description.text: Shot in the live-action, cinematic register of
, the frame opens on near-total darkness inside a wide, empty showroom floor.

sits facing the camera, motionless, its black body only barely separated from the surrounding blackness. A single thin edge of ambient light traces the low shoulder line and the front wing, grazing the weave of the carbon-fibre panels before the falloff swallows the rest of the shape. The floor is unlit and matte in the foreground; a faint, cold sheen appears only where that edge light reaches it, so the ground plane reads almost as a horizon rather than a surface. The air above the car holds a soft haze that keeps the background without detail: no walls, no signage, nothing but graded black. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, so the silhouette gradually grows and resolves out of the dark without ever becoming fully lit; the rear of the vehicle and the space behind it stay lost. Nothing else in the room moves. The stillness and the slow drift of the frame carry the beat, holding
as a dark, poised mass waiting for its first motion.
Low room tone and a faint electrical hum fill the dark hall.

slowly resolves out of the darkness as the camera drifts inward.
The cut lands as the vehicle breaks its stillness:

pulls forward out of the dark, rolling toward camera. Light rises across the carbon-fibre body as it advances, catching the front splitter first, then the long bonnet and the curved wings, so the black panels keep their deep tone while the leading edges sharpen into bright, narrow highlights. The polished showroom floor slides past beneath the car, a soft grey sheen widening under the nose and stretching back into shadow, and the wheels turn visibly against it. The camera tracks with the subject at small amplitude and slow speed, holding a medium-wide scale so the emerging strip of lit floor and the rising light on the body both stay in frame, with the background still drowned in darkness. The car closes the distance steadily; the bonnet and front intake swell in the lower frame, the glass throws a brief reflection, and the body's dark mass finally separates cleanly from the void around it. The shot ends with the vehicle still rolling forward, half in light, half in shadow.
A soft engine hum starts and tyres whisper across the polished floor.

soundscape: Low room tone with a faint electrical hum in the darkness, resolving into the soft hum of the car's engine and the whisper of tyres on a polished floor.
music: A measured ambient score: sustained low strings and a slow synth pad that swell gently as the car emerges into the light.

claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
a black sports car on a showroom floor
A thin edge of ambient light traces the car's body while the rest of the hall stays unlit.
The showroom floor is polished and reflective, sliding past beneath the moving car.
A low room tone and faint electrical hum give the darkness presence, and a soft engine hum follows the car's forward roll.

summary.text: waits on an empty showroom floor, then pulls forward as light rises across its body.
